_readme: The launcher's Events banner (home, above the news). Edit this file and push to main: running launchers read it from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, then cdn.jsdelivr.net where GitHub is blocked) at the start and every 15 minutes - no new launcher needed. Shown: what goes on now and what starts within 14 days, nearest first, one card at a time. start / end: ISO time WITH its zone (2026-11-08T18:00:00+03:00); end is optional; the card shows the day and the start time in the player's own time. title: a string or {"ru": "...", "en": "..."} (es / fr / de fall back to en). info: up to 3 short points under the title - a list, or {"ru": [...], "en": [...]}. url: optional, an icon on the card opens it. id: any unique text.

ru: Формат: 1vs1, одна раса на весь турнир
en: Format: 1vs1, one race for the whole cup
